info.longName: Yieldmax Gme Option Income Strategy ETF

funds_data.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks current income while providing indirect exposure to the share price (i.e., the price returns) of GameStop Corp. (NYSE: GME) (“GME” or the “Underlying Security”), which is generally subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is non-diversified.
